headline: "Already done" is an answer on the review queue (with an undo that really un-confirms), session notes file themselves with a safety copy and an honest refusal for custom files, and the weekday morning digest chat retires with its jobs folded into the weekly rhythm.

items.prompt_template: Three changes worth knowing. First, the review queue has a new answer: 'already done' — the promise was real and you already handled it off-mail. One tap books it and closes it as completed, recorded honestly as your word at review time; it works one item at a time on purpose, and undo returns the item to the queue instead of leaving a closed record. Second, long session-notes files now roll themselves into dated archives during weekly maintenance — always with a full safety copy first, and a file too custom to split safely is left untouched and offered as 'roll over my session notes' instead. Third, the weekday morning digest chat is retiring: quiet-project detection now runs weekly (a project only goes dormant after a question you were asked lapsed unanswered — any answer stops it), the questions wait at 'stalled projects', and intro follow-ups answer to 'check my intros'. If the old chat is registered here you'll be offered its retirement — nothing switches off silently.
